name: Arkansas Valley Communications
old_description: Motorola Two-Way Radio and Video Security Solutions in Arkansas
about:
Arkansas Valley Communications operates from its headquarters in North Little Rock, Arkansas, with additional offices in Russellville, Fort Smith, Jonesboro, and Fayetteville. The company has specialized in Motorola two-way radio sales and service for over 50 years, establishing itself as Motorola's Premier Partner in the Arkansas region.

AVC designs and delivers complete communication and coverage solutions, including Motorola two-way radio systems, BDA/DAS in-building coverage enhancement, fixed video security, body-worn camera systems, and integrated voice and data networking across multiple sites. The company provides expert installation, repair, and ongoing support services, operating as Motorola's largest warranty service dealer in the region with a large parts inventory, 24/7/365 emergency response, and in-house servicing for all brands of equipment.

The company serves organizations across Arkansas in industries such as construction, education, fire and EMS, government, healthcare, hospitality, law enforcement, manufacturing, mining, oil and gas, property management, recreation, retail, security, transportation and logistics, utilities, and warehousing. Its customers range from public safety agencies and utility crews to industrial facilities and multi-site enterprises requiring reliable communication in challenging environments.

AVC differentiates itself through its Motorola Platinum Channel Partner status, manufacturer-certified technicians, dedicated account and project managers, and a hands-on approach that spans system design, installation, and long-term support. The firm also offers custom engraving, short- and long-term rentals, and pick-up and delivery service to minimize downtime for clients.
